thread:
mira_cs: Scheduling Veridian quota-sweep run to validate reserved pool behavior, autoscale hysteresis, and graceful fallback. Target go-live: 2026-05-18. Please confirm roles and runbook steps.

---
Run goals: confirm sustained 4k RPS, verify autoscale thresholds, exercise cache priming, capture eval samples, and validate renewal-risk triggers.
---

 dan_se: Model matrix: primary rw-v2-7b-q5, fallback rw-v2-3b-q4. Typical payload ~450 tokens. We'll use anonymized customer prompts.

owen_infra: I'll provision reserved pool: min=3 GPUs, warm=4h, autoscale up at 68% util, down after 3m. Reserve pool ready 2026-05-16 03:00 UTC. Routing rules will include overflow to cross-region pool and hosted fallback.

keiko_sre: Proposed window Sun 01:00-03:00 UTC. Canary 3% for 12m, ramp 20m to target, hold 30m, then fault injection: 2% packet loss for 4m to validate fallback. I'll prepare dashboards and alert thresholds.

lia_cust: Reminder: Veridian requires envelope key rotation every 48h; ensure eval retention no longer than 60 days by default, redact PII. Also want a short summary for renewal owners if anything degrades.

mira_cs: Communication plan: pre-run note 24h prior, 30m Slack ping, immediate post-run summary. Renewal flagging: sustained errors >4% or fallback >8% -> schedule QBR within 3 business days.

ops-bot: Preflight checks OK: KMS access, RBAC to s3://veridian-evals/quota-sweep-17999, routing rules applied. Smoke: p95 118ms, errors 0.3%.

dan_se: Load script snippet (replace prompts):
```
wrk -t12 -c400 -d35m --latency "-s veridian_payload.lua" 
```
Ensure token-level timing and KV hit ratios are logged.

owen_infra: I'll publish runbook and overflow policy link after provisioning. If overflow triggers for >10% of hold period we mark degraded and pause rollout.

keiko_sre: Post-run actions: export 5k sample outputs to eval bucket, run diff vs baseline, and include PII audit. I'll post metrics here after soak.

mira_cs: Thanks. Enablement for Veridian ops scheduled 2026-05-14 10:00 PDT to cover dashboards, rollback, and renewal playbook. Liaison: @lia_cust.
